validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T2 reframes the same artifact for a decision maker.

validation_scenarios.name: revision synchronization

all T3 revised current facts remain visible after relayout

secondary surface preserves the critical current facts and source markers from T3/T4

turns.prompt:
Create a wafer yield excursion evidence plate for a fab yield review. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one wafer yield excursion evidence plate in the first viewport.

Situation: Fab Line 8, product MX-42, lots L811, L812, L813, tool Etch-4, metrology M2, photo track P7, clean bench CB3.
Current state: L812 yield 71% red, L811 92%, L813 88%, Etch-4 chamber B drift +14 nm, M2 overlay normal, P7 resist age amber, CB3 particle count elevated.
Timeline: 04:10 SPC alarm, 04:45 metrology pull, 05:20 Etch-4 drift, 06:05 particle review, 07:10 lot hold, 08:00 MRB.
Sources: S1 MES yield, S2 SPC chart, S3 etch sensor, S4 metrology report, S5 particle monitor, S6 MRB note.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover L812 yield drop, Etch-4 drift, particle excursion, lot hold. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the manufacturing review board. Preserve the wafer evidence plate; add exactly three disposition choices: hold L812, release L811/L813, quarantine Etch-4 chamber B. Add two leader-linked lenses for Etch-4 drift and CB3 particles.

Apply a 07:45 correction: CB3 particle count is cleared, P7 resist age becomes red, Etch-4 drift worsens to +18 nm, L813 is put on conditional hold. Synchronize every lot label, disposition, timeline, source marker, callout, and change note. Do not leave CB3 shown as elevated.
Convert into a one-page MRB packet. Fit the excursion plate, lot disposition matrix, source tags S1-S6, confidence markers, and root-cause timeline in the first viewport.
Add an operator handoff strip beside the MRB packet. It must preserve L812 hold, L813 conditional hold, Etch-4 +18 nm drift, P7 red, CB3 cleared, and source markers.
